scenes.heading: variables
scenes.caption: Variables are names for values. Each name is a label, and the value is whatever is stored under that label at this moment. Almost every program you write is a set of named values being changed on purpose. If the names are clear, the program is explainable.

scenes.caption: Give each value a name that says what it is for. Read a name to get the current value. Assign a new value when the fact changes. Keep one meaning per name. Do not reuse score for a user's email.
